responsibility: Declares the AArch64 runtime CPU feature enumeration shared between GCC and libgcc for feature detection and function multiversioning. The file’s sole responsibility is to assign stable numeric IDs to architectural capabilities such as crypto, SVE/SME, memory tagging, and related extensions, including reserved markers for extended feature fields and initialization state, so that runtime CPU-probing code and AArch64 multiversion dispatch logic can communicate through a consistent feature-bit layout compatible with compiler-rt/LLVM.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem i386 header, this AArch64 file is only a compact shared feature-ID enum for AArch64 multiversioning and libgcc/LLVM-compatible runtime probing; it does not define CPU model structs, bit-manipulation helpers, or cpuid-based detection logic, which are specific to gcc/common/config/i386/cpuinfo.h.
